topic.title: Telling agents about the competition seems to harm their effort/performance/focus.
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
I notice that when I compile info for my agents on a competition they very quickly find the public notebooks and try to proceed form that, rather than build on the approaches I ask em to start out with, breaking continuity & dare I anthropomorphise: breaks morale for them.

how do you handle this issue

This is more a general kaggle experience rather than something particular to this competition.
